block_reviews.review: Disinflation from completed consumer/producer releases is distinguished from the Fed projected one-cut path and completed equity closing record. Reuters auto weakness is linked to uncertainty over the response, without assuming retaliation completed. Lane/Lagarde patience is attributed correctly; unsupported first-cut completion language was made conditional. French national vote remains pending, and no enacted fiscal program or later outcome is asserted. Playbook separates valuation relief from commercial earnings.

All eight China parts checked: slow housing sales and destocking policy; exports versus imports; overseas app demand; credit-cycle commentary; inventory and bank analysis; company localization views; own-session Shanghai/Hang Seng marks; inflation and competitive pricing. CNN BYD statement is attributed analysis. Policy tools, factories and relending are not described as completed earnings recovery; divergence and cash tests are specific.

BOJ decision remains pending and the Reuters preview is not converted to an outcome. Bond purchases and rates remain distinct policy instruments. GDP revision, service sentiment and wholesale inflation are completed earlier releases. Nikkei marks use own completed session. Currency discussion explains conditional transmission without prohibited spot FX levels.

AFR forecast of iron-ore pressure is kept separate from Reuters import/output commentary and from domestic household evidence. ABC and AFR attribution matches metadata. No commodity-price ratio is used as growth evidence. Miner and consumer additions have separate operational triggers and invalidations.

Seven Poland parts checked against all Polish and regional titles. WIG20TR tracker is not presented as an index point level or measured outflow. Labor revival and banker optimism are attributed assessments; future public pay decision is distinct from realized spending. LPP completed sales/inventory/margin evidence is differentiated from Pepco withdrawal, Orlen appointments, KGHM affordability and PKO Leasing ambition. Patriots report/response, G7 agreement and defense preparation are not treated as completed deployments, contracts or conflict outcomes.

Broadcom forecast and completed share response are supported by Reuters. After root clock adjudication, n1096 Adobe beat/reaction was removed; Yahoo n1469 establishes only completed quarterly reporting. Software cash/adoption statements are prospective mechanisms. No Adobe beat, guidance increase or after-hours percentage survives.

Spotify creative agency and AI voiceover test remain announced/test-stage; adoption, revenue and delivery economics remain conditional. Meta senior-rank efficiency is an organizational initiative, not realized savings. Playbook requires commercial cash and preserved capability.

Goldman planned private-bank lending expansion is not completed balance growth; Visa/Mastercard settlement remains in peril, not a final judgment. The comparison distinguishes underwriting from legal economics without claiming either company is a proxy for the other.

OMV longer-term management guidance is an outlook, while IEA surplus is a future industry forecast. No realized surplus, guaranteed commodity path or fulfilled guidance is stated. Earnings watch uses asset economics and funding rather than unsupported quantities.

FedEx cuts are a planned demand response; Airbus overtime is sought to address delayed A220 production. This supports the comparison of weak freight demand with output constraints. No intended saving, completed staffing reduction or production catch-up is assumed.

Shein price increase and prospective IPO are Reuters-supported; Stellantis CEO intended correction now has its own CNBC n1217 citation in the same paragraph. DFS warning is attributed to Red Sea disruption. Demand, delivery and pricing outcomes remain conditional.

Dollarama sales-growth miss is supported by Bloomberg.com; Le Monde regional boycott pressure is not generalized to all brands or measured as a universal collapse. The block uses the companies as everyday-purchase comparisons without claiming ETF membership or invented sales totals.

WSJ Lilly success and desire for a successor are differentiated from an approved replacement. Reuters doctors view of potential broader male demand is prospective, with no measured patient count. Product evidence, access and safety are explicit triggers and risks.

Reuters iron-ore imports versus steel output is commentary about downstream-demand quality; solar price freefall and request for government action are current company/industry news. No inventory amount, completed policy support or immediate margin floor is invented.

Crest Nicholson completed loss is a company result; Chinese destocking support and slow sales are policy/activity context in a separate market. No rate rally is treated as completed property recovery. Cash collections and financing obligations ground the conditional stance.

Google/Nevada geothermal partnership and NextEra Energy Resources/Entergy development deal are announced commercial channels, not operating capacity. Company roles are preserved, with funded milestones and cash return conditional; no invented ownership stakes or realized utility earnings.

Reuters regional auto-stock reaction is completed; Chery factory mitigation remains the company assessment. Retaliation, localization profitability and a manageable settlement are future alternatives. Selective stance has cash-based triggers and no announced tariff treated as guaranteed protection.

Broadcom completed June13 regular-session response is distinguished from its June12 result/guidance. AVGO 1678.99 USD and +12.27% are exact as-traded card values.
